# CRX API Quickstart

> The CRX API Quickstart pages of Discover and the CRX FIX API page, in Markdown. The taker and maker pages match the live Discover pages. SDK: https://github.com/crxfoundation/crx-python. Blocks tagged `crx-*` are Discover page elements.

## Pages

- [Taker API Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/taker-quickstart.md): Request quotes, trade and read your book on CRX.
- [Maker API Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/maker-quickstart.md): Open a 100 USD maker test trade and read it back.
- [CRX FIX API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/quickstart.md): Trade FX non-deliverable forwards on CRX from a FIX 4.4 engine. The [Rules of Engagement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/rules-of-engagement.md), the dictionary [FIX44-CRX.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/FIX44-CRX.xml) and the sample messages in fix/examples/ are beside it.
- [CRX signature proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/signature-proxy.md): The signature proxy is a small program that signs for the seat.

## Scripts

- [Taker script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/taker-script.py): the taker steps as one script.
- [Maker script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/maker-script.py): the maker steps as one script, with more calls.
